 Kings vs. Mavericks: Sacramento Is Undefeated in November (Please Don’t Check)
 The 0-6 Kings visit Cooper Flagg and the 4-2 Mavs in Dallas with a new month, a new hour, and a Jerry Reynolds wish list. 
 By RobHessing | 49 Comments | Nov 2, 2026 
 Jan 6, 2026; Sacramento, California, USA; Dallas Mavericks forward Cooper Flagg (32) reacts after missing a shot next to Sacramento Kings forward Precious Achiuwa (9) in the second quarter at the Golden 1 Center. Mandatory Credit: Cary Edmondson-Imagn Images
 Your 0-6 Sacramento Kings travel to the home of the Ewings (JR, not Patrick – ask your parents) to take on the Dallas Mavericks. The Mavs are currently 4-2, while the Kings are…uh, the Kings are still looking for their first…uh, the Kings are currently only three games out of the play-in!
 Let’s Kings basketball!
 Who : Sacramento Kings (0-6) vs. Dallas Mavericks
 Where : American Airlines Center, Dallas, Texas
 When : 5:00 PM PT / 8:00 PM ET
 Watch : NBC Sports California / League Pass / At Your Own Peril
 Turn the page, because the Kings are undefeated in November, and undefeated during Daylight Savings Time (yes, the hour will change everything!). The Kings are relying on their first six games of tape lulling the Mavs into a false sense of security, while Dallas has viewed the tapes and are relying on a real sense of security.
 Fun fact: The Mavs have a 19-year-old, too! In fact, Cooper Flagg is a full month younger than Darius Acuff. But it appears that Flagg has arrived in his second year, beginning the season with a nifty 26.8 ppg / 6.3 rpg / 6.6 apg line that is supported by an eFG% of 59.7. He has all the appearance of what Kings fans are praying for from Acuff: franchise cornerstone.
 Aside from experience, Flagg also has an upper-level partner (Kyrie Irving) and solid contributors in PJ Washington, Daniel Gafford, and Max Christie
 And because you’re Kings fans, you deserve a break. So, without further ado, a word from Jerry Reynolds:
 “As an NBA fan, I’m looking forward to watching a revamped Mavs team with Kyrie back joining young franchise player (Cooper Flagg) and coaching addition Dusty May. I just hope Kings decide to run offense to Sabonis as well as through him. Side note would love to watch Sharp with Acuff a lot more and start developing Lavine as a 6th man to help this useless bench. Also, hopeful to see Coach Christie stop patting guys on the butt for awful play. Hurting some feelings is OK by me!”
 OK, this is where I have to lie to you and make like the Kings have a chance. Read this in Mark or Kayte voice for extra effect. Acuff rocks, Domantas Sabonis rolls, Zach LaVine gets three steals while playing solid defense, and (choose one) Emanuel Sharp / Nique Clifford / Mike Woodson goes nuts from beyond the arc and the Kings pull off the stunner.
 Injury update: LaVine is questionable with right elbow inflammation and Dylan Cardwell is questionable.
 Prediction : Kings 119, Mavericks 118.
 Cooper Flagg / Dallas Mavericks / Darius Acuff Jr. / Domantas Sabonis / Sacramento Kings
